pillarRumors: "West Apocalypse Arc." An old pilot spits on the ground. "Alanossa controls every gram of fuel that comes in or out. You want through? You'd better have a good reason — or a good reputation."
"I saw Alanossa once." The woman speaks without looking up. "Small. Calm. The kind of calm that tells you the person stopped being afraid a long time ago."

"Cesarion has run the Emporium for fifteen years." The man fills his glass. "Not the type to wave weapons around. He buys people before they become problems. Smart, or dangerous — hard to tell the difference."
"If you're looking to trade legit in this sector, sooner or later you go through Cesarion." The merchant shrugs. "He's fair. But he forgets nothing."
"The Velkor Archives." The old man says it quietly. "Eliotis spends his days there. He says he's looking for answers about the Nexus. Others say he's looking for something much older. Maybe both."
"I worked for Eliotis for two years." She puts away her tools. "He knows things. Old things. He doesn't share them easily — but he shares them with those who deserve to hear them."
"Scotty." The pilot laughs. "Everyone knows him in the deep zones. A ghost. Shows up when he wants, disappears the same way. He knows paths that don't exist on official maps."
"I was told to find Scotty if I needed a discreet passage." The smuggler lowers his voice. "I looked for him for six weeks. He's the one who found me. That chilled me."
